verdict.rationale: Kick's Bill Pay tab lets you view and manage bills with real-time sync from Ramp or BILL, giving visibility into outstanding bills and AP aging, but the docs explicitly state Kick does not execute vendor payments itself, and there is no documented approval-routing workflow within Kick — payment execution and scheduling depend on the connected Ramp/BILL platform. missing for 10: in-app approval routing/workflow for bills, native payment scheduling/execution, evidence of end-to-end single-workflow capture-approve-pay.
